title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents

details.title: ToolHazard: Scaling Adversarial Environments for Security Evaluation and Alignment of LLM-based Agents
details.abstract: In this study, we propose ToolHazard, a scalable adversarial environment synthesis framework that enables agent security evaluation and adversarial alignment across broader application domains.

title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract

details.title: Agent Safety Should Be a Runtime Contract
details.abstract: Agent safety shouldn’t stop at training: our new paper argues for runtime contracts that block dangerous actions and require checkable evidence that agents actually did what they claim.
